item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia is significantly expanding glide-bomb production and its ministry is urging underground data centres after Ukrainian drone attacks, while Russian forces continue daily strikes that killed two civilians and injured 35 across Ukraine. Ukraine has hit a chemical plant in Russia's Voronezh region and is conducting deep-strike missions up to 2,500 km, targeting sites such as a titanium plant, a Tolyatti factory and a Krasnodar Krai airfield. European defence ministers met in Paris to discuss support and the UK and France are conducting joint exercises aimed at Crimea, as Zelenskyy says trilateral peace talks with Russia are set to restart. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Heavy fighting erupted near Baidoa and in Burijeed as Laftagareen forces attacked army positions, prompting UN calls to halt the fighting amid famine, displacement and flood risks.
